name: Create an ingress rule
description: Create an ingress rule Create a new ingress rule for the specified sinkhole. POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/intel/sinkholes/{sinkhole_id}/ingresses
context:
POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/intel/sinkholes/{sinkhole_id}/ingresses
Create a new ingress rule for the specified sinkhole. The CIDR block must be a Cloudflare BYOIP associated with your account. The zone_id must be a zone with the ability to create Spectrum Apps. The sinkhole must belong to the same account as the zone.
Required: zone_id (path) — The unique identifier for the Cloudflare zone.; sinkhole_id (path) — The unique identifier for the sinkhole.; body (body)

name: Delete an ingress rule
description: Delete an ingress rule Delete the specified ingress rule. DELETE /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/intel/sinkholes/{sinkhole_id}/ingresses/{ingress_id}

name: Get an ingress rule
description: Get an ingress rule Get the specified ingress rule associated with a sinkhole. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/intel/sinkholes/{sinkhole_id}/ingresses/{ingress_id}

name: Update an ingress rule
description: Update an ingress rule Replaces the specified ingress rule. PUT /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/intel/sinkholes/{sinkhole_id}/ingresses/{ingress_id}
